s.t:
Zirtual is a work-life balanced company that provides clients with experienced, highly skilled remote assistants for both personal and professional needs. Our Executive Assistants are committed to delivering efficient, proactive, and high-quality support that meets and exceeds client expectations.
The Executive Assistant is a vital member of the Zirtual team and serves as the primary point of contact for assigned clients. In this role, you will work independently while receiving support from an Account Supervisor, who will assist with client relationships, plan adjustments, quality feedback, and ongoing guidance.
As an Executive Assistant, you will play a critical role in supporting busy professionals by managing schedules, communications, and day-to-day operations. You will help streamline workflows, anticipate needs, and ensure tasks are completed efficiently and accurately.
Assistants are expected to be available for clients during business hours as agreed upon with each client but around-the-clock availability is not expected. Responsibilities also include sending weekly usage reports, responding to communication within a two-hour window, maintaining detailed client profiles, and following Zirtual's best practices for success.
This role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Typical Duties and Responsibilities (may vary based on client needs)
Calendar & Schedule Management
Manage and coordinate complex calendars and appointments
Schedule meetings, calls, and events across multiple time zones
Anticipate scheduling conflicts and proactively resolve them
Email & Communication Management
Monitor and manage inboxes, including drafting and responding to emails
Prioritize communications and ensure timely follow-up
Serve as a liaison between clients and internal/external contacts
Administrative Support
Prepare documents, presentations, and reports
Handle data entry, file organization, and record maintenance
Assist with project coordination and task tracking
Travel & Event Coordination
Research and book travel arrangements (flights, hotels, transportation)
Create detailed itineraries and manage travel changes
Coordinate virtual and in-person meetings or events
Operations & Task Management
Support day-to-day business operations
Conduct research and compile information as needed
Identify opportunities to improve processes and efficiency

Skills & Attributes
Strong organizational and time management skills
Excellent written and verbal communication
High attention to detail and accuracy
Ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines
Proactive, resourceful, and solution-oriented mindset
Ability to work independently in a remote environment

Bilingual (English/French and/or Spanish)
Experience supporting executives, entrepreneurs, or small business owners

Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Business Administration or related field (or equivalent experience)
2-4+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, or similar role

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams
Zirtual is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Zirtual representatives and offer job seekers false interviews or job offers. These scams often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.
To help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following points in mind:
No Financial Requests: Zirtual will never ask for payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates
No Equipment: Zirtual does not provide equipment and does not request candidates to pay for equipment

Direct from Zirtual: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @zirtual.com address
Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @zirtual.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Zirtual, please report it immediately to support@zirtual.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts

About Scrunch Scrunch, a Sitecore company, is on a mission to bring brands to an AI-first future—where people increasingly rely on LLMs to discover, understand, and act on information that matters to them.

As AI search and conversational agents replace traditional web search and browsing, Scrunch helps marketing teams rethink how their products and services are discovered and surfaced on AI platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and more—working with AI platforms, not against them.

This shift represents the biggest change to marketing since the dawn of the internet. Today, more than 500 paying brands—including Fortune 500 companies like Lenovo, category-defining brands like Akamai, ADP, Lenovo and breakout startups like Clerk—use the platform. About the Role This is not a calendar-and-travel-only role.

You’ll be the operational backbone for the founders - anticipating needs, creating systems, removing friction, and making sure nothing slips through the cracks. You’ll handle both professional and personal priorities so the founders can focus on leading the company. You’ll also help train us to work better with you.

Own and manage complex calendars, meetings, and travel - ruthlessly prioritizing for impact.
Act as a gatekeeper for time and energy; help the founders focus on what matters most.
Prepare agendas, capture and track action items, and follow up relentlessly.
Coordinate across the leadership team and with external partners.
Handle personal errands and life admin to keep the founders’ lives running seamlessly.
Create and refine processes for scheduling, information flow, and task tracking.
Anticipate needs before they’re expressed, and resolve problems before they arise.
Serve as an NYC office on-site point of contact for day-to-day office needs, visitors, deliveries, and vendors.
Coordinate with building management on access, maintenance, and facilities requests
Assist with internal events, team gatherings, and all-hands meetings
Maintain NYC office supply inventory and manage reorders
Support ad hoc administrative or operational tasks as needed

Proven experience as an EA, ideally in a fast-paced startup or high-growth environment.
Exceptional organizational skills, with a bias for action and follow-through.
Strong judgment, discretion, and ability to handle sensitive information.
Clear, concise communicator - both written and verbal.
Proactive, adaptable, and unflappable when plans change (and they will).
Comfortable balancing both personal and professional responsibilities for executives.
If you’re resourceful, highly organized, and energized by making other people’s lives run better, we’d love to meet you.

Specific duties include: The Executive Assistant supports MDEO's Executive Director by independently coordinating administrative functions to include correspondence, communications, personnel management, financial support, meeting schedules, scheduling of briefings including hearings, suspense and control items, space needs, and other analysis of information or refinement of recommendations and proposals.

Assists the Executive Director on highly visible and important formal responses, testimonies, and hearings. Works on Congressional testimony and hearing preparation; assists with establishing or articulating VA's position on broad issues with significant and wide-ranging impact.

The incumbent completes special projects that are complex in nature and have significant impact on VBA initiatives. The work requires a high level of interaction with VBA senior leaders and the issues are typically controversial and highly visible.

Maintains a broad knowledge and understanding of VA and VBA policies, missions, automation, and operating programs and must remain acutely aware of administration policies and government-wide initiatives having a direct impact on VBA and MDEO. The incumbent applies expert analytical skills and division goals in evaluating various program areas.

The incumbent uses expertise and judgment in creating recommendations for the Executive Director. Exercises objectivity and awareness of the mission and responsibilities of the Executive Director in the priority setting process.

The incumbent screens visitors and telephone calls by obtaining background information to determine which calls or visitors must be directed to the Executive Director, others, or can be handled personally.

Provides technical assistance and guidance on preparation, coordination, and administrative processing of executive office actions including conducting research to develop presentations, briefings, and other executive materials.

Initiates and drafts memoranda and position papers, together with other special reports and analytical studies on items of special interest or controversial issues that are of high department or public interest. Exercises a high level of judgment in determining and advising on courses of action.

Presents, or arranges for presentations, regarding matters related to current policy and program changes. The incumbent develops standard procedures involving the administrative operations for the office and develops systems which monitor, track, and control a wide variety of items requiring action by the Executive Director and staff for the office.

Prepares, edits, and reviews incoming and outgoing executive communications, briefing papers, correspondence, and other materials. Prepares presentations, spreadsheets, databases, and other materials utilizing appropriate technology. Provides executive summaries, interpretation of policy implications, or cogent recommendations pertaining to content.

Acts as a gatekeeper to prevent inappropriate requests, incomplete proposals, inconsequential issues, and erroneous facts. Confirms appropriate stakeholders have identified and resolved all relevant information, prior to requesting executive leadership signature or endorsement.

Independently resolves issues and provides a complete solution so the Executive Director only needs to give approval or disapproval of the proposal. The EA works with the MDE budget team, in preparation of the administrative budget, ensuring it is ready for Executive Director review and concurrence.

Maintains continued awareness of overall activities in order to evaluate effectiveness and to keep the Executive Director informed and recommends actions to strengthen operating and administrative policies and procedures, and/or to advise staff on priority matters of concern.

Takes final action in connection with the application of managerial and administrative functions that are within delegated authority.

Incumbent is required to be aware constantly of the overall MDEO program and to recognize those areas with which the Executive Director should not be burdened, what actions and commitments should be made without reference to her/him and what matters require his/her counsel or decisions before arriving at final conclusions.

At the heart of one of the world's leading reinsurance companies, this is your opportunity to play a pivotal role supporting a senior leader who shapes Swiss Re's global underwriting strategy. If you thrive in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment and take pride in bringing order, precision, and calm to complexity - we want to hear from you.

As Executive Assistant to the Group Chief Underwriting Officer (GCUO), you will be a trusted partner and the operational backbone of one of Swiss Re's most senior executives.

This is far more than a traditional EA role - you will be a strategic enabler, ensuring the GCUO can focus on what matters most by seamlessly managing the flow of information, people, and priorities around them.

Your discretion, agility, and proactive mindset will be essential as you navigate a dynamic, international environment at the highest levels of the organisation.

* Diary & Schedule Management: Proactively manage a complex, fast-moving calendar, anticipating conflicts and ensuring the GCUO's time is optimally allocated across priorities
* Strategic Prioritisation: Apply sound judgement to strategically prioritise requests and competing demands, ensuring the GCUO's focus and energy are directed where they matter most
* Gatekeeper Role: Act as a trusted gatekeeper for inbound requests, managing access to the GCUO with professionalism, tact, and efficiency
* People Leadership: Lead, develop, coach, and empower 1 or 2 direct reports, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous growth within the executive office
* Correspondence Management: Handle, prioritise, draft, and coordinate high-volume incoming and outgoing communications in both English and German, ensuring clarity, professionalism, and timely follow-up
* Deadline Tracking: Maintain a rigorous overview of key deadlines and deliverables, proactively flagging and escalating where needed to keep commitments on track
* Meeting Preparation: Compile, organise, and ensure the timely availability of briefing materials, presentations, and background documents for meetings and engagements
* Financial Administration: Manage expense reporting and process incoming invoices accurately and efficiently in line with company policies
* Stakeholder Coordination: Serve as the central coordination point between the GCUO, senior leadership, key internal and external stakeholders - building trusted relationships across all levels
* Confidentiality & Judgement: Handle highly sensitive and confidential information with the utmost discretion, sound judgement, and professionalism at all times
* Operational Excellence: Continuously identify opportunities to improve processes and ways of working to enhance the effectiveness of the executive office
### ###

This role sits within Group Underwriting, a high-impact function at the core of Swiss Re's business. The Group Underwriting team is responsible for setting and steering Swiss Re's global underwriting strategy, standards, and frameworks across all lines of business.

Working at the intersection of risk, strategy, and leadership, the team operates with a global remit and collaborates closely with senior leaders and business units across the organisation. As EA to the GCUO, you will be embedded at the very centre of this influential team, supporting its most senior leader.

You are a seasoned, highly organised professional who brings calm authority and sharp judgment to everything you do. You are someone who anticipates needs before they arise, communicates with confidence and tact across all levels of seniority, and takes genuine pride in enabling others to perform at their best. You understand the weight of working in a confidential, high-visibility environment and you handle it with grace and integrity.

The two co-founders carry the work that decides this company: product, clients, the investor network, the brand. Their time is the scarcest resource in the business, and protecting it will be your mandate.

You manage both calendars across time zones, own both inboxes, plan and oversee travel, prepare the founders for the meetings that matter, and ensure every commitment they make is kept. This is a position of ownership, not a list of tasks.

You exercise judgment, act independently, and involve the founders only when a decision genuinely requires them. You work AI-first, like the rest of the company: tooling carries the mechanical work, and your time goes to judgment, anticipation, and trust.

You report directly to both co-founders and hold one of the most trusted positions in the company.

Both calendars across time zones: scheduling, conflicts resolved before they surface, preparation time protected, and our Monday and Thursday meeting rhythm maintained.
Both inboxes: triaged daily, replies drafted in each founder's voice, nothing important left waiting.
Travel end to end: planned, booked, briefed, and resolved in real time when plans change.
Meeting preparation and follow-through: the right briefing beforehand, actions captured and pursued afterward.
The commitment layer: what the founders have promised, to whom, by when, tracked to completion.
The systems behind it all, built on the best AI tooling, so mechanical work never requires attention twice.

Have supported a founder or C-level executive at a fast-moving company, and can describe what never required their attention because of you.
Have managed calendars across three or more time zones and understand the craft: buffers, batching, protected working time, and declining requests on someone else's behalf with grace.
Write well enough to draft in another person's voice, and judge well enough to know what can be sent without asking.
Have owned travel end to end, including disruptions resolved before the principal ever felt them.
Can support two principals at once: competing priorities held, both agendas moving, neither founder resolving minor conflicts.
Treat discretion as a reflex: names, transactions, and conversations remain confidential, always.
Build systems rather than task lists: standing rhythms, documented processes, and automation that outlasts your busiest week.
Operate with modern tooling: AI runs your scheduling, briefings, and follow-ups, so your time goes to judgment rather than administration.

Fully remote. This position operates in real time across the founders' working day rather than asynchronously. **Rejoignez Nescens, la marque suisse experte en longévité.**
Nescens est une institution suisse de référence dans les domaines de la médecine préventive et de la longévité. Elle réunit deux univers complémentaires : une ligne de skincare scientifique, nos cosméceutiques, distribuée dans un réseau de point de ventes sélectifs et en ligne, et des programmes de bilan diagnostique et de longévité dispensés en clinique et dans des établissements hôteliers partenaires de référence.
Basée sur le prestigieux campus médical de Genolier, Nescens fait partie d'un écosystème unique où la science, la médecine et le bien-être se rencontrent.
Rejoindre Nescens, c'est intégrer un environnement dynamique, stimulant et tourné vers l'innovation, au cœur de la science suisse de la longévité.
## Description du poste ##
Ce poste vient renforcer l'équipe Guest Journey Coordinator, déjà composée de deux personnes, dans le cadre du développement et de l'expansion des programmes Nescens : multiplication des programmes (Essential Reset et suivants), montée en volume de la clientèle internationale haut de gamme, et déploiement progressif sur de nouveaux sites.

Il répond au besoin d'un lead supplémentaire dédié à l'expérience client, capable de garantir la cohérence et la qualité du parcours à mesure que l'offre s'étend, et de soutenir l'Innovation Program Manager dans le déploiement terrain de chaque nouveau programme.

Le GuestJourney Coordinator est le lead de l'expérience client sur les programmes Nescens : il anime le parcours du client de bout en bout, coordonne l'ensemble des intervenants, et incarne la promesse haut de gamme de la marque. Le poste intègre certains gestes techniques simples, réalisés sous délégation médicale. Il apporte également son expertise terrain au Program Manager dans le développement de nouveaux programmes, et est référent formation auprès des équipes.

\- Être l'interlocuteur unique du client avant, pendant et après le programme, afin de garantir un accompagnement continu, individualisé et une expérience haut de gamme.

\- Porter la relation client comme un ambassadeur de la marque Nescens, au même titre qu'un rôle d'hôte : anticiper les besoins, personnaliser l'expérience, gérer les imprévus avec fluidité.
\- Recueillir les retours clients en continu et les faire remonter pour nourrir l'amélioration de l'expérience et des programmes.

\- Assurer l'interface avec les équipes hôtelières et spa pour la bonne exécution logistique des séjours.
\- Assurer la gestion administrative et du dossier client, de sa constitution à son suivi, incluant la traçabilité et la facturation.

Le projet entre maintenant en phase de réalisation : pour le compte de la coalition, le **bureau HEKS** **de Zurich/Schaffhouse prend en charge la coordination opérationnelle du projet pilote et développe le réseau de bénévoles.** Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec la coalition, les communes impliquées et d-autres partenaires. La mise en œuvre est prévue dans le canton de Zurich et fera l-objet d-une évaluation scientifique.
Souhaitez-vous mettre en œuvre un projet pilote innovant avec une société civile engagée ? Prendre volontiers des responsabilités, participer activement et rassembler différents acteurs ?
Nous recherchons pour le **1er novembre 2026** ou à convenir une personne dynamique, autonome et compétente en tant que

* **Gérer et développer la mise en œuvre du projet pilote :** coordonner les activités, mettre en place les processus et structures nécessaires, tout en gardant à l-œil les objectifs, jalons, ressources et risques.
* **Recruter et accompagner les bénévoles** : recrutement, introduction, formation, planification des missions et accompagnement professionnel des bénévoles ainsi que promotion des échanges et du réseautage entre les personnes engagées bénévolement.
* **Soutenir les bénévoles dans l-accompagnement à l-intégration :** identifier avec les bénévoles les besoins et défis des réfugié·es participant·es, offrir une orientation et assurer la mise en réseau avec les communes ainsi que les services spécialisés et de soutien.
* **Favoriser la collaboration et le réseautage :** rassembler les communes, services spécialisés, partenaires de projet et autres acteurs pertinents, organiser la communication et garantir un flux d-informations fiable.
* **Assurer la documentation et le reporting :** préparer soigneusement les informations pertinentes pour les financeurs, partenaires de projet et l-évaluation scientifique, et garantir la documentation du projet.

Our client is a profitable, fast-growing U.S.-based digital marketing and eCommerce agency that helps consumer brands scale through performance media, creative strategy, advanced measurement, and AI-powered solutions.
The agency combines human expertise with cutting-edge technology to deliver measurable business results, focusing on profitability, efficiency, and sustainable growth rather than vanity metrics.
With strategic partnerships across leading advertising and social commerce platforms, including Google, Meta, TikTok, Snap, and Pinterest, the company operates at the forefront of digital marketing innovation.
The team embraces an AI-first mindset, entrepreneurial thinking, operational excellence, and a culture of ownership, where individuals are encouraged to take initiative, make decisions, and contribute directly to business growth.

We are looking for a highly proactive and business-minded Executive Assistant / Chief of Staff to work directly with the founders and leadership team of a fast-moving digital marketing agency.
This is not a traditional administrative or scheduling position. It is a hands-on role that combines executive support, operational management, vendor oversight, process improvement, and business development.
The ideal candidate is a resourceful professional who takes ownership of responsibilities, exercises independent judgment, anticipates business needs, and makes decisions with minimal supervision.
You will oversee executive priorities, manage vendor relationships, optimize operational systems, and develop processes that improve efficiency across the organization. You will also contribute directly to revenue-generating initiatives by supporting prospect research, outbound outreach, pipeline development, and marketing activities.
We are looking for someone who thinks like an operator, executes like an executive assistant, and brings the commercial mindset needed to help a growing business scale.

Executive & Founder Support
Manage executive calendars, inboxes, meetings, and communications, independently handling routine scheduling and prioritization decisions.
Act as a trusted point of contact between leadership, internal teams, vendors, and clients.
Anticipate executive needs, prioritize competing demands, and ensure timely follow-through on commitments.
Prepare meeting agendas, executive briefings, status reports, and other materials, synthesizing information to support effective decision-making.
Coordinate founders' personal appointments, scheduling, and occasional personal administrative needs with professionalism and discretion.
Vendor Relationship Management
Take ownership of day-to-day vendor relationships, including communications, issue resolution, service quality, and performance expectations.
Evaluate vendor proposals, negotiate routine pricing and contract terms, and approve purchases within established authority limits.
Monitor vendor performance against agreed service standards and recommend improvements or alternative providers when necessary.
Maintain accurate vendor documentation, contracts, and compliance records.
Identify potential vendor-related risks and escalate significant contractual or financial matters to leadership.
Operational Systems & Technology
Own the administration, organization, and continuous improvement of the company's operational tools and technology platforms.
Evaluate new software and AI-powered solutions, recommend improvements, and manage implementation and onboarding.
Troubleshoot operational system issues and coordinate with vendors when additional technical support is required.
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve productivity through technology.
Ensure operational systems support business objectives and remain organized, efficient, and scalable.
Process Design & Operational Improvement
Analyze existing workflows, identify operational inefficiencies, and independently develop improved processes.
Create, implement, and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), operational playbooks, and training documentation.
Establish clear workflows, quality control checkpoints, and accountability standards.
Identify operational risks and proactively implement corrective actions within the scope of the role.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency, reduce manual work, and support business growth.
Financial & Administrative Management
Monitor operational budgets, track expenditures, and flag potential variances.
Manage routine procurement decisions for software, supplies, and services within approved spending limits.
Maintain organized financial and administrative records.
Support leadership with operational reporting, expense tracking, and administrative planning.
Business Development & Revenue Support
Proactively contribute to revenue-generating activities when operational priorities are under control.
Research and qualify prospective clients, develop targeted prospect lists, and identify potential business opportunities.
Support outbound prospecting through personalized email campaigns, LinkedIn outreach, follow-ups, and lead nurturing.
Maintain accurate CRM records, track pipeline activity, and coordinate next steps with the business development team.
Prepare sales presentations, proposals, pitch decks, case studies, and other business development materials.
Coordinate go-to-market initiatives, including sales meetings, webinars, industry events, and strategic partnerships.
Support the agency's own marketing initiatives, including newsletters, social media, and content coordination.
Collaborate with leadership to identify opportunities to improve prospect engagement and accelerate the sales process.

Required
3+ years of experience in executive support, business operations, administrative management, or a similar role involving significant independent responsibility.
2+ years of hands-on experience in sales, business development, or marketing, including prospecting, pipeline development, outbound outreach, or campaign support.
Advanced English proficiency (C1 or higher), with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Demonstrated experience supporting senior executives or managing operational functions with minimal supervision.
Proven ability to independently manage vendor relationships, including negotiations, performance monitoring, and contract coordination.
Experience designing, documenting, implementing, and improving operational processes.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Sound business judgment, with the ability to make independent decisions and recognize when leadership involvement is necessary.
